title: The 8 Best Mini Table Saw 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for mini table saw 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at mini table saw 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: DEWALT 15 Amp 8-1/4 Inch Compact Portable Jobsite Table Saw DWE7485
products.blurb: Key specs: 15-amp motor with 24.5-inch rip capacity, Rack and pinion telescoping fence, 16-inch maximum rip right of blade.
strengths: Rack and pinion fence locks parallel and stays put through long cuts
15-amp motor handles hardwood without bogging
Site-pro modular guarding system is quicker to adjust than guarding on older DEWALT models
Compact enough to transport to job sites but stable enough for shop use
limitations: Dust collection port requires an adapter for standard shop vac hoses
No dado stack capacity, blade arbor not long enough
features: Integrated storage for blade guard, push stick, and miter gauge
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

features: Dust elbow for shop vac connection
